title: OntologyDataGraph
description: A bounded page of term-to-asset clusters, connected semantic context, and observed lineage for ontology data mode.

clusters.description: Ranked term-to-asset clusters in this page followed by bounded connected context clusters. Paging applies only to the ranked clusters.

seedTermIds.description: Ranked term identifiers represented by this page. Connected context clusters are excluded.

edges.description: Bounded semantic and hierarchy relations whose endpoints are present in the returned clusters.

lineageEdges.description: Bounded observed lineage whose endpoints are assets in the returned cluster previews.

paging.description: Offset pagination for ranked seed clusters, excluding connected context clusters.
